Nested msig (spec 2026-11-02-msig-nested, CTR-UA-09): every row the same shape as portable.json's. registrations: in the order they register, each record's member first. An msig slot is MemberSig{index, members: InnerSig{index, sig}[], sig: 0x}, a signing slot MemberSig{index, [], sig}. md_I = keccak256(I | ua_msg(0x0120, member, md_U)): innerDigests[j].memberDigest, for the row's memberDigest md_U; a derived leaf of I signs under member over md_I, a native leaf the row's typed digest in the portable purposes and UAAuth(id, member, md_I) elsewhere (context A of structures.json, gen 1). msig-nested-twice: one native signature serves both slots of that record (N5). kemRecords, pqzKeyRecords: as portable.json's. memberships: acceptMembership(ua, MemberSig{index, members, sig}) in the order they run, a member of msig kind by its accepted slots over innerDigest(member, memberDigest) (sig 0x). authorizations: requireAuthorized(ua, purposeTag, digest, UASig{0x, 0x, members}), valid or refused UAUnauthorized. negatives: registerMsig of `row` with `pop`, refused with `error`, every member signature otherwise as a registering one. structures: registerMsig refused UAMemberUnknown(member) by the records (a third level, an unregistered inner). eligibility: msig_pqz_eligible(keyData) with inner = id -> key data. All of it UNAUDITED.
